acceptanceCriteria: The MCP bridge exposes the static preview with byte-identical output to the CLI and the same refusals, covered by a parity test; or the spec records MCP static as a non-goal.
body: Residual from V1-2045/2046 (PR #1319, LPCV-V0-150..153). `corvint test-validity --static` is CLI only; the MCP test-validity bridge cannot request the static preview (NOT_PRODUCED). Expected: an MCP parameter with identical bytes and the same option-combination refusals, or a recorded non-goal.
title: MCP test-validity bridge has no --static source-hygiene preview equivalent
